**Cisco Meraki - Networks - Create Network**

Create a network in Meraki Organization. To create a combined network, select more than one Product Types task will automatically create the network as combined type.

**Target:** A Meraki Endpoint using HTTPS "api.meraki.com" port 443 and no path.

**Account Key:** Meraki User API Key. API Key can be generated from Meraki Dashboard -> User Profile -> API Access.

Steps:
[] Sends Create Network request to Meraki
[] Check if the request was successful:
[]> If it was, attempt to extract the results and set the output variables
[]> If it wasn't, check if "Ignore If Exits" input is set to true.
[]>> If it was, skips the "name already exits" error and marks the workflow as completed successfully.
[]>> If it wasn't, return the error and marks the workflow as failed.

NOTE: Empty attributes in the request are removed from the payload before sending to Meraki. 

More information about this API: https://developer.cisco.com/meraki/api-v1/create-organization-network/

properties.description: This is the unique identifier for the organization. Example: "2930418". It's used to reference the organization in API calls.

properties.description: The name of the organization. This is the display name used in the Meraki Dashboard.

properties.name: Output - License Model
properties.description: An object detailing the licensing model used by the organization. Example: "co-term" indicates a co-termination licensing model where all licenses expire on the same date.

properties.name: Output - Cloud Region Details
properties.description: An object providing information about the cloud region associated with the organization. Example: The name of the region, like "North America"

properties.name: Output - Error Message
properties.description: The HTTP error message of the API response.

properties.name: Output - Management Details
properties.description: An object containing management-related details. Example: label for a management detail, such as "MSP ID".

properties.name: Output - Organization URL
